messages.导出全部匹配分组，不受表格分页影响: Export all matching groups, including unloaded pages
messages.导出失败，请重新登录后重试。: Export failed. Please sign in again and retry.
messages.选择统计方式、时间范围和对比对象，在同一张表或图中查看结果。: Choose a metric, time range and items to explore in one table or chart.
messages.按记录更新时间筛选，结束时间不包含在内。: Filtered by record update time; the end time is exclusive.
messages.设置已修改，点击“应用分析”更新结果。: Settings changed. Apply the analysis to update the results.
messages.已达到 8 个对象上限，可取消已选项后继续选择。: 8-item limit reached. Remove a selection to choose another.
messages.没有匹配对象，请调整搜索或时间范围。: No matching items. Adjust the search or time range.
messages.开始时间必须早于结束时间。: The start time must be earlier than the end time.
messages.仅列出时间范围内含有效数字的字段；数字字符串也可参与统计。: Only fields with valid numbers in this range are listed; numeric text is included.
messages.当前时间范围内没有可用的数值字段，可改用记录数或调整时间范围。: No numeric fields in this range. Use record count or change the time range.
messages.使用已保存历史；记录搜索和最新/历史切换不影响分析。: Uses saved history; record search and latest/history selection do not affect analysis.
messages.按分析时间范围比较已保存历史；对象精确匹配，空周期不补零。覆盖更新仅保留当前快照: Compares saved history in the analysis range. Items match exactly and empty periods stay blank. Upsert keeps only the current snapshot.
messages.自动采集的数据会在这里持续更新。: Collected data is continuously updated here.
messages.浏览已完成的追踪表记录，点击记录可展开全部字段。: Browse completed tracker records; open a row to see every field.
messages.浏览已完成的追踪表记录，点击记录可展开全部字段、编辑字段或删除记录。: Browse completed tracker records; expand a row to edit a field or delete the record.
messages.一次只修改一个字段，最多 2000 字。保存后分析结果会更新。: Edit one field at a time, up to 2,000 characters. Analysis updates after saving.
messages.原值超过 2000 字，输入框仅显示前 2000 字；保存会替换整个字段。: The current value exceeds 2,000 characters. Only the first 2,000 are shown; saving replaces the entire field.
messages.记录不存在或无权编辑。: Record not found or edit access denied.
messages.只能编辑已完成的记录，请等待处理结束。: Only completed records can be edited. Wait for processing to finish.
messages.记录已更新，请刷新后重试。: The record changed. Refresh and try again.
messages.单元格已更新，请刷新后重试。: The cell changed. Refresh and try again.
messages.记录已被其他操作更新，请刷新后重试。: Another action changed the record. Refresh and try again.
messages.部分记录不存在或无权删除，请刷新后重试。: Some records are missing or cannot be deleted. Refresh and try again.
messages.部分记录仍在抽取中，请处理完成后再删除。: Some records are still being extracted. Wait until processing finishes before deleting.
messages.记录状态已变化，请刷新后重试。: The record status changed. Refresh and try again.
messages.一次最多删除 500 条，请缩小选择范围。: Delete up to 500 records at a time. Select fewer records.
messages.仅展示已完成的记录；待确认、失败和抽取中的记录请到追踪表处理。: Showing completed records. Review pending, failed, and running records in the tracker.
messages.先看最新一次成功采集的数据，也可切换到全部历史记录。: View the latest successful collection or switch to the full history.
messages.先看最新一次成功采集的数据，也可切换到全部历史记录；展开记录可编辑字段或删除记录: View the latest successful collection or the full history; expand a record to edit a field or delete it.
messages.名称、来源 ID 或字段内容: Name, source ID, or field content
messages.按时间周期统计，在同一结果表查看数值与逐期变化。: Group by a time period to view values and period-over-period changes in one results table.
messages.周期统计使用上方日期范围和已保存历史，对象值精确匹配；搜索、字段筛选及最新/历史: Period stats use the date range above and the saved history, with an exact object match. Search, field filters and the latest/history switch do not change the result. Empty periods are not zero-filled; overwrite updates keep only the current snapshot.
messages.周期模式使用上方日期范围和已保存历史，对象值精确匹配；搜索、字段筛选及最新/历史: Period mode uses the date range above and saved history, with an exact item match. Search, field filters and the latest/history switch do not affect period results. Empty periods remain blank; upsert retains only the current snapshot.
messages.该对象在当前日期范围内没有已完成记录。: No completed records for this item in the selected date range.
messages.输入对象值后应用分析。: Enter an item value, then apply the analysis.
messages.分析暂不可用，请检查上方提示。: Analysis is unavailable. Check the message above.
messages.按字段分组并统计当前筛选范围；数值字符串会按可解析数字计算。: Group and summarize the filtered records; parseable numeric text is included.
messages.任务运行后，这里会显示最近一次状态。: The latest run status will appear here.
messages.显示该数据源的当前记录（覆盖更新模式）。: Showing current records for this source (upsert mode).
messages.显示最近一次成功采集的批次记录。: Showing records from the latest successful batch.
messages.显示已保存的全部历史记录；日期按记录更新时间筛选。: Showing all saved records; dates filter by record update time.
messages.当前范围没有采集记录。: No collection records in this range.
messages.当前范围没有追踪记录。: No tracker records in this range.
messages.当前范围没有可绘制的数值。: No numeric values to chart in this range.
messages.图表显示已加载的分组；点击“显示更多分组”继续查看。: The chart shows loaded groups; select “Show more groups” to continue.
messages.当前范围没有可汇总的记录。: No records to summarize in this range.
messages.记录数基于全部匹配记录。: The count includes all matching records.
messages.数值统计排除空值和无法解析的内容；表格列出实际参与计算的条数。: Numeric metrics exclude empty or unparseable values; the table shows the valid count.
messages.选定一个对象，按记录更新时间比较不同周期的数值与变化。: Choose an item to compare values and changes across periods by record update time.
messages.输入对象后回车添加，可加多个: Type an item and press Enter; add as many as you need
messages.对比对象数量已达上限，先移除一个再加。: Item limit reached; remove one before adding another.
messages.当前范围或口径没有可绘制的数值。: No values to plot for this range and metric.
messages.点击在图里显示该对象: Click to show this item in the chart
messages.点击从图里隐藏该对象: Click to hide this item from the chart
messages.点击图例可显示或隐藏某个对象。: Use the legend to show or hide an item.
messages.这些对象在当前日期范围内没有已完成记录。: These items have no completed records in the selected dates.
messages.输入或点选至少一个对象值，再应用分析。: Enter or pick at least one item, then apply.
messages.使用上方数据源和日期范围；留空日期时查看最近一段时间。对象值精确匹配，趋势按历史: Uses the data source and date range above; leave dates blank for a recent window. Item values match exactly, and trends use saved historical snapshots.
messages.使用上方日期范围；留空时查看最近一段时间。对象值精确匹配，趋势按可见历史记录统计: Uses the date range above; leave it blank for a recent window. Item values match exactly, and trends use visible historical records.
messages.请输入该字段的对象值，然后点击“比较趋势”。: Enter an item value for this field, then select “Compare trend”.
